stage: Development reproduction of a published reduced motor timing component, not a SAN or held-out biological test
sourceConfiguration: Author Berger_SNL and Berger_SNIC JSON files; numeric initial traces and coupling arrays from the same archive

nativeAudit.purpose: Identify numerical consistency with saved native samples without fitting physiological parameters

network.initialization: Exact last-interspike native reference selection used by source Figure 3B, separately for SNL and SNIC
network.gapConvention: Gap current is evaluated at the start of a step and held for its intrinsic RK4 stages, reflecting the source's separately summed synaptic variable; coupled Brian output is not available for exact comparison

measurements.phaseDefinition: Linear interpolation between consecutive declared spikes, only where all five phases exist
measurements.include: Every planned case, finite-state/gate checks, frequency, all spike times and observed numerical differences

comparisons.weakVsNone: Same intrinsic parameters and initial phase selection; removes electrical coupling
comparisons.weakVsStrong: Same intrinsic parameters and phase selection; changes gap strength
comparisons.SNLvsSNIC: Published parameter regimes change both Shab conductance and input current, not a channel-only intervention

boundaries: Native initialization curves are author model outputs, not animal voltage recordings
